missing_info: CMMS is down (503), so the repair estimate relies only on the radio call from Maintenance (at least 4 h, pump suspected). There is no confirmed work order, parts availability or ETA.
Telemetry is baseline only, with no live status for LH-07 or LH-11, so it does not confirm the failure or show where each loader is now.

Tonnes are spread evenly over 07:00-17:00. Actual tonnes already loaded at TP-1310-04 before 09:18 are unknown, so the figures are estimates. Taking the full planned 300 t / 81.0 oz as the at-risk figure for do_nothing gives a higher number.
LOADER-BACKUP-02 is a builder assumption not yet validated by the project owner. Without it, LH-04 at TP-1220-01 (3.9 g/t) would be the lowest-grade donor.
Whether TP-1310-04 has a muck pile ready for loading and a free access route for LH-11 is not confirmed.
The 0.5 h to 1 h activation time of the reserve stopes was not used. Reserve stopes were not considered because no free loader is available.
